{{Quote|We must now enter the mystical mind lattice of Wat Tambor.|The Skakoan Elders|<ref name="Wat Tambor">{{StoryCite|book=Star Wars: Visionaries|story=Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops}}</ref>}}
The '''mind lattice''' was a method of entering an individual's mind in [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] culture. In approximately [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Skakoan [[Elders (Skakoan)|Elders]] entered the mind lattice of [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], where they gave him the task of venturing to the [[Threshold of the Hidden Realms]] to retrieve the [[Eye of the Albino Cyclops]]. Tambor attempted to recuse himself with the excuse that his mind lattice was calibrated for the quickening, but the Elders insisted.<ref name="Wat Tambor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mind lattice was mentioned in "[[Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops]]," a comic story written and illustrated by [[Michael Murnane]] for the [[2005]] anthology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]''.<ref name="Wat Tambor" />
